description:
Step 2 of zaq-rft. See parent for authoritative shared fixture schema, paths, corpus design and reuse assessment. Related feature: zaq-4mu.

Tests first using temporary fixture directories and the existing HTTP stub: exact text sent, default fill-missing behavior, idempotent rerun/no calls, refresh-all behavior, input drift, configured model/dimension mismatch, malformed provider response, zero vector, network/rate-limit error and write failure. Verify that text, expectations and unrelated JSON fields survive unchanged.

Implement `mix retrieval.eval.embed [--path DIR] [--refresh]`:

1. Start the app in the selected Mix environment and read configured embedding settings. Default to repository fixture directory; read configuration without altering it or the ingestion database.
2. Validate all files in preparation mode. Default operation fills null embeddings only. Existing stale or incompatible embeddings fail with instructions to use `--refresh`; never mix embedding spaces silently.
3. Generate sequentially through Embedding.Client using exact chunk content and semantic queries. Deduplicate identical inputs within the invocation. Preserve existing client error semantics; terminate clearly on rate limit rather than adding an unbounded retry loop.
4. Validate dimension, finite coordinates and nonzero norm, including norm after halfvec conversion. Confirm configured model/dimension remained stable during generation.
5. Stage all responses before writing anything. Write deterministic UTF-8 JSON to sibling temporary files, then atomically rename per file. A multi-file update is not a filesystem transaction: retain recovery data and report exactly which files changed if a commit-stage rename fails. No fixture is ever left truncated.
6. Print counts and changed paths, never vectors or credentials. Missing configuration/provider failure exits nonzero with actionable file/field context.

Module responsibility: task orchestrates; fixture helper owns file/schema mechanics; Embedding.Client remains the only provider implementation.

Action reuse assessment: reuse SearchKnowledgeBase/Jido.Exec, NodeRouter and Embedding.Client as described in the parent. Fixture parsing and file updates are local-only developer tooling; no new agent tools or production retrieval behavior. Read applicable AGENTS.md policies before implementation. Do not skip missing vectors or weaken relevance assertions.

comments.text: Generator implementation and unit tests added locally after fixture validation; focused tests: 6 tests/1 property pass; mix q passes. Generator reuses configured Embedding.Client and stages all vectors before per-file atomic rename; testing configured provider availability next. Step 1/2 remain uncommitted and their Beadwork dependency open pending authorized landing.

Implemented mix retrieval.eval.embed with configured Embedding.Client, exact input hashing, provenance, fill-missing/--refresh, upfront provider staging, sibling temp+rename per file and no expectation rewriting. Generated 45 distinct bge-multilingual-gemma2/3584 vectors (12 chunks + 33 semantic variants); idempotent rerun 0 calls/0 file updates. Focused generator tests pass. No credentials or endpoints stored in JSON. Uncommitted; issue not closed pending landing authorization.

Coverage plan for lib/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval/embed.ex lines 74, 101, 125-126; planning only, no code edits. Owner: test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs (existing async: true). Functional contract: Embed.prepare!/5 deduplicates exact texts across document chunks/question semantic queries per invocation, rejects invalid vectors before writes, and reports committed paths if a per-file atomic rename fails; leave production Mix.Tasks.RetrievalEval.Embed unchanged. Action reuse: not applicable — tests only, no changed executable operations or new Action/tool/consumer; preserve existing local-only Mix helper, Fixtures and Embedding.Client contracts. No new service docs necessary unless a behavior change becomes necessary; do not expose a production test seam. No feature E2E: offline developer tooling, not a UI journey.

Test-first scenarios, exact path test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs:
1) Cache hit, line 74: reuse with_fixture_copy/1. Decode documents/english-travel.json, set second chunk content to the first chunks content (both remain verbatim in existing markdown, IDs/index/language and question references stay unchanged), write JSON. Pass injected embed closure that records exact text in test-local state (e.g. Agent started via start_supervised!, or ETS owned by test), returns [1.0,0.0]. Assert prepare! result embedded equals number of DISTINCT missing inputs and updated paths include expected 4 files; first duplicated text called exactly once; both persisted chunk embeddings equal the returned vector and input_sha256 equals Fixtures.input_hash(duplicated_text); judged question expected/forbidden and unrelated content preserved. Do not assert incidental order of all provider calls. Re-run and assert updated:0, embedded:0, and no provider call as existing test does.
2) Bad successful provider payload, line 101: with_fixture_copy/1, snapshot exact bytes of every documents/questions JSON. Inject embed returning {:ok,[1.0]} for dimension 2 (optionally separate {:ok,[0.0,0.0]} for zero-norm boundary) after a valid first response, using test-local counter; assert ArgumentError includes offending fixture path and invalid embedding response/expected 2 coordinates (or zero-norm embedding). Assert every original file byte-for-byte unchanged and no *.tmp-* sibling files. Existing test already covers {:error,:unavailable} line 105; avoid duplicating it.
3) Rename failure, lines 125-126: with_fixture_copy/1, choose questions/english-travel.json (last of documents ++ questions). Snapshot its original bytes and source document bytes. On first embed callback only, move the question JSON to a sibling .backup and mkdir at its original pathname (directory target makes real File.rename(temp,target) return {:error,reason}; no OS permissions or Mox/global patch). Use try/after to remove only that owned directory and restore backup before with_fixture_copy teardown even when assertions fail. Return valid vectors for all inputs. Assert ArgumentError contains exact question path, fixture rename failed, and already updated with the three documents paths in sorted order; source documents now contain valid vectors, restored question bytes equal original, and no temporary siblings remain anywhere. Do not assert OS-specific reason atom or claim cross-file rollback: successful earlier renames are intentionally retained. If rename-to-directory behaves differently on target platform, use a deterministic real-filesystem conflict, never a production-only seam or global File mock.

Reuse: existing with_fixture_copy/1, clear_embeddings/2, Fixtures.load!/2, Fixtures.input_hash/1 and per-test temporary directory. Embed closure is the controlled external provider boundary; real Fixtures validation and File operations remain active. No global state or sleeps; callback executes synchronously, so no wait/poll needed. Test-only filesystem mutations are per-test unique paths and restored by try/after; retain async: true. Property test not warranted for these three concrete side-effect/error/cache paths; vector validation broad input-space properties belong to Fixtures tests, not duplicate private logic. Run only mix test test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs when implemented; issue validation subsequently follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md (mix q + isolated tests, final precommit gate when applicable); coverage-upper handoff only after review. Do not run coverage/full suite now. Dependency graph unchanged: zaq-rft.1 -> zaq-rft.2 -> zaq-rft.3.

Coverage-plan implementation complete in test/mix/tasks/retrieval_eval_embed_test.exs: added cache deduplication across duplicate chunk inputs, invalid successful vectors (wrong dimension and zero norm) preserving exact file bytes/no temp files, and real rename-failure reporting with retained earlier commits and fixture restoration. Implementation only per handoff; no tests, formatter, coverage, or full validation run (coordinator to authorize). Ticket remains open.
